name: com.unity.burst
description: Burst is a compiler that translates from IL/.NET bytecode to highly optimized native code using LLVM.

_upm.changelog:
### Added
- Added LLVM 22 and 23 support.

### Removed

### Changed
- Changed the default LLVM version to 23.

### Fixed
- Fixed the Burst Inspector disassembly search bar requiring a second Ctrl/Cmd + F press to reopen after being closed.
- When launching Unity Arm64 version, from an X64 host process (e.g. github launcher), burst bundles would not be correctly signed, causing process exit.
- Fixed Burst AOT linking on QNX failing with `No such file or directory` for every generated object file, because the linker paths were passed with literal quote characters.
